save_checkpoint_oss: save a JAX pytree checkpoint to disk with optional compression and step copy
load_checkpoint: load a JAX pytree checkpoint from an NPZ file using tree structure recovery
load_params: load model parameters from a big_vision checkpoint supporting submodel key selection
npload: load an NPZ file and return a dictionary of numpy arrays or a single array
recover_dtype: recover bfloat16 dtype from numpy void type stored by np.save
